A LITTLE CLARITY

Your questions, answered.

For your wedding. For your business.

FOR COUPLES

More joy. Less figuring it out.

What can I do without signing in?

Browse published suppliers, read the guides and use the public budget calculator, checklist and wedding-day timeline. An account is needed to save and manage your own dashboard.

How do the wedding credits work?

Earn $1,000 in wedding credits for each complete $10,000 paid through the WedSparks payment function. Use your credits towards supplier payments through the same payment function. Credits cannot be withdrawn as cash.

Does entering an expense earn credits?

No. Only money paid through the WedSparks payment function earns credits. Recording an expense or outside payment in the budget does not count.

Can guests reply online?

Your invitation links let guests respond according to the reply permissions you choose. You can track replies in your private couple dashboard.

Why pay suppliers through WedSparks?

Every complete $10,000 paid through WedSparks payments earns $1,000 in free wedding credits. Credits can be used only through WedSparks payments. Keeping your payments with your booking records also helps you stay organised.

FOR SUPPLIERS

A better home for your business.

What does it cost to join as a supplier?

Listing and core tools are free. Suppliers pay an 18% commission on invoices paid by couples through WedSparks. Couple Leads is an optional $50/month subscription.

Can I import my existing business details?

The separate business-details import page accepts your own supported files for review and draft saving. Automatic profile-link extraction is not yet connected.

What is Couple Leads?

An optional $50/month supplier subscription for discovering couples in the supplier’s area who have opted in to hearing from businesses. It is separate from the free supplier listing.

Does importing publish my business?

No. Importing and saving are draft actions. Publishing is a separate choice.
